purpose: Frozen allow-list for the package runtime/ tree. The publish gate compares the packed runtime files against exactly this list: anything not listed, listed-but-modified, or listed-but-missing blocks the release. It is never regenerated from the working tree at gate time.
treeDigestScheme: sha256 over sorted "path<LF>sha256<LF>bytes" entries joined by LF, path relative to the package root
